description: Roads by country (OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific, on HDX) is a series of datasets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP). This the transportation network of Thailand. This data comes from GISTA The Thai Space Agency. Coverage: 6 countries and territories, one dataset each (for example Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, Papua New Guinea). The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP). Its tags are facilities-infrastructure, geodata, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-02-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
